_comment: Airport passenger throughput, FY 2024-25, used to derive route weights at evidence rung 3 (airport-throughput proxy). This is NOT city-pair traffic, which is what rung 1 would require and which no public DGCA table provides.
_source_quality: SECONDARY. These figures are reported by Wikipedia's 'List of busiest airports in India' citing AAI, and corroborated independently by bharatspeaks.com and aviationjeta.com, which report identical values for FY2024-25. The primary source is AAI's own traffic statistics, which should be obtained and substituted before any publication. Treat as rung 3, not rung 1.
_known_distortion: These are TOTAL passengers, domestic plus international. APIx collects domestic routes only. Delhi and Mumbai carry large international volumes, so this proxy overstates them relative to a purely domestic measure. Stated rather than silently corrected, because applying an invented domestic/international split would be a worse error than a labelled one.

route_level_check._comment: One genuine route-level observation, used to test the proxy rather than to build it.
route_level_check.source: IATA World Air Transport Statistics 2024: Mumbai-Delhi was the 7th busiest airport pair globally, carrying 5.9 million passengers in 2024
